samples.question: The colored route crosses the small ring at its midpoint. Read the four equal-width large bends from the left end toward the ring, then the four from the ring toward the right end. Compare each bend's distance from the straight baseline through the bend boundaries. Does the right-side sequence repeat the bend sizes in the same order, or in reverse order? Answer same or reverse.
